topic: ThirdRowMapLamp control signals for LHZCU (Left Hand Zone Control Unit)
row_semantics: Each row represents a distinct signal interface related to the third-row map lamp control, detailing its direction, type, sender, receiver, and specific signal values.

column_semantics.Interface Name: The name of the signal interface.
column_semantics.Direction: Indicates whether the signal is an input or output.
column_semantics.Type: Specifies the data type or nature of the signal (e.g., internal).
column_semantics.Sender/Provider: The component/module that sends or provides the signal.
column_semantics.Receiver/Consumer: The component/module that receives or consumes the signal.
column_semantics.Channel: The communication path or channel used for the signal.
column_semantics.Interface Source: The source or origin of the interface definition.

core_entities.name: ThirdRowMapLampLHSwReq
core_entities.description: Input signal from LHZCU to control the third-row map lamp switch request.

core_entities.name: ThirdRowMapLampLHBrtLvl
core_entities.description: Output signal from LHZCU to set the brightness level of the third-row map lamp.

core_entities.name: ThirdRowMapLampLHSts
core_entities.description: Input signal from LHZCU to report the status of the third-row map lamp.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control signals for the third-row map lamp within the LHZCU system, specifying how the lamp can be switched on/off, adjusted in brightness levels, and reported status. It is used for testing the correct mapping and response of these signals between the sending and receiving LHZCU modules.
